# tools: cleanup Brewfile

Act on `brew doctor`'s warnings after `self-update`:

```
Warning: Some installed casks are deprecated or disabled.
  grammarly
Warning: Some installed formulae are deprecated or disabled.
  hey
Warning: The following casks have the same name as core casks:
  1password/tap/1password-cli
Warning: The following formulae have the same name as core formulae:
  goreleaser/tap/goreleaser
  goreleaser/tap/nfpm
  isacikgoz/taps/gitbatch
  isacikgoz/taps/tldr
  octolab/tap/goimports
  octolab/tap/golangci-lint
  rs/tap/curlie
  traefik/tap/yaegi
```

i.e. drop deprecated packages and stop using third-party taps for things Homebrew core now provides.
